v: na॰ jaWaraM sAdfSyenAstyasya arSa॰ ac rasya laH । jaWaravadudakADAre “catasro nAzWo jaWalasya juzwAH” f॰ 1 । 182 । 6 । jaWalasya jaWaravadudakADArasya” BA॰ ।
m: जठल (= 2. जठर, ‘cavity [of waters], ocean’, Sāy.), i, 182, 6.
a: जठलं — Ved. The cavity or receptacle of waters.

v: pu॰ jaWarasTito'gniH । kOkzeye annAdipAcake vahnO “annarasojaWarAgninA pacyamAnoraktatAM pratipadyate” mitAkzarA jaWarAnalAdayo'pyatra “jaWarAgnirhi vAyunA saMDukzyamARo'nnaM pacati tatpakAro yogArRave ukto yaTA “AyuzyaM BuktamAhAraM sa vAyuH kurute dviDA । saMpraviSyAnnamaDyaM tu pfTak kiwwaM pfTak malam । agnerUrdDaM jalaM sTApya tadannaYca jalopari । jalasyADaH svayaM prARaH sTitvAgniM Damate SanEH । vAyunADmAyamAno'gniratyuzRaM kurute jalam । annaM taduzRatoyena samantAt pacyate punaH । dviDA Bavati tat pakkaM pfTaka kiwwaM pfTag rasam । rasena tena tA nAqyaH saMpUryyante kranaRa ca । pratarpayanti sampUrRAstASca dehaM samantataH” ।
m: जठराग्नि m. digestive stomach-fire, gastric juice, Gṛhyās. i, 11; Kathās. lxxiii, 58; Hcat.
cf. जाठर.

s: puM, (jaWarasya Amayo rogaH .) jalodararogaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ (atIsArarogaSca । tasya cikitsA yaTA, -- “kapitTamaDyaM lIQvA tu savyozakzOdraSarkaram । kawPalaM maDuyuktaM vA mucyate jaWarAmayAt ॥” iti carake cikitsAsTAne daSame'DyAye ॥)
v: pu॰ 6 ta॰ । udararoge rAjani॰ atisAraSabde 106 pf॰ dfSyam । jaWaragadAdayo'vyatra । “Bavati DaraRi je caturTage jvarajaWaragadAsfguquva” vf॰ sa॰ 104 a॰
m: जठरामय m. ‘stomach-disease’, dropsy, L.
जठरी-कृत mfn. ‘contained in the belly’, concealed in the bosom, BhP. iii, 9, 20.
a: जठरीकृत — a. 1 Contained in the belly. --2 Concealed in the bosom.

s: tri, (jawati ekatrIBavatIti । jawa + bAhulakAdaraH WAntAdeSaSca । yadbA, janayate iti । jana + “janerarazWa ca .” uRAM 5 । 38 । iti araH WaScAntAdeSaH .) badDam । kaWinam । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (yaTA, SAntiSatake । 4 । 13 । “idAnImasmAkaM jaWarakamaWapfzWakaWinA manovfttistat kiM vyasanivimuKEva kzapayasi ॥”)

puM klI, (jAyate garBo malaM vA asminniti । jana + “janerarazWa ca .” uRAM । 5 । 38 । iti araH WaScAntAdeSaH .) udaram । iti medinI ॥ (yaTA, hitopadeSe । 2 । 44 । “pfzWataH sevayedarkaM jaWareRa hutASanam । svAminaM sarvvaBAvena paralokamamAyayA ॥” deSaviSeze, puM । sa tu kUrmmaviBAge AgneyyAM diSi varttate । yaTA, bfhatsaMhitAyAm । 14 । 8 । “AgneyyAM diSi koSalakaliNgavaNgo pavaNgajaWarANgAH ॥” taTAca mahABArate । 6 । 9 । 42 । “ata UrdDvaM janapadAn niboDa gadato mama .” ityupakramya, -- “jaWarAH kukurAScEva sadaSArRASca BArata ! ॥” ityuktavAn ॥ parvvataviSezaH । yaTA, BAgavate । 5 । 16 । 27 । “jaWaradevakUwO meruM pUrvveRAzwAdaSayojanasahasramudagAyatO dbisahasrapfTutuNgO BavataH ॥” udararogaviSezaH । “rAjI janma balInASo jaWare jaWarezu tu .” iti nidAnasTAne dbAdaSe'DyAye vABawenoktam । etatsamprAptiryaTA, suSrute nidAnasTAne 7 aDyAye । “kozWAdupasnehavadannasAro niHsftya duzwo'nilaveganunnaH । tvacaH samunnamya SanEH samantAdbivardDamAno jaWaraM karoti ॥”)
v: puMna॰ jAyate janturgarBo vAsmin jana--ara--WAntAdeSaH । 1 kukzO । 2 badDe, 3 kaWine ca tri॰ medi॰ । 4 deSaBede “ataUrdDaM janapadAn” ityupakrame “jaWarAH kukurAScEva sadarSArRASca BArata!” BA॰ BI॰ 9 a॰ । “Aste'syAH jaWare vIryyamavizahyam suradvizAm” BAga॰ 7 । 7 । 9 । “vAyuvegasamO vIrO jaWarO turagottamO” rAsA॰ ayo॰ 107 । 13 । “yaH kadAcit samyak pacati kadAcidADmAnaSUlodAvartAtisArajaWaragOravAntrakUjanapravAhaRAni kftvA sa vizamaH” suSru॰ । jaWarayantraRA jaWaravyaTA jaWarAmayaH ।
m: 1. जठर mf(आ)n. (v.l. for बठ्˚, q.v.) hard, firm, Śāntiś. iv, 13 & Sāh. (v.l. जरठ);
for जरठ, old, Bhartṛ. iii, 92
= बद्ध, L.
for जवन, R. ii, 98, 24
अति-, ‘very hard’ and ‘very old’, Śiś. iv, 29
जठर m. N. of a man, Pravar. iv (Mādh.)
of a mountain, BhP. v, 16, 28
pl. N. of a people (in the south-east of Madhya-deśa, VarBṛS. xiv, 8), MBh. vi, 350.
2. जठर n. [m.] the stomach, belly, abdomen, bowels, womb, interior of anything, cavity, RV.; AV. &c.
certain morbid affections of the bowels, Car. vi, 1; Suśr. i, vi
जठर, [cf. γαστήρ ?; Goth. kilthei or qvithrs].
a: जठर — a. [जायते जंतुर्गर्भो वास्मिन् जन्-अर ठांत देशः Tv.] 1 Hard, stiff, firm. --2 Old. --3 Bound, tied. --रः, --रं 1 The stomach, belly, abdomen; जठरं को न बिभर्ति केवलं Pt. 1. 22. --2 The womb. --3 A hole, cavity. --4 The interior of anything. --5 The bosom. --6 Morbid affection of the bowels. --Comp. --अग्निः the digestive fire of the stomach, the gastric fluid. --आमयः dropsy. --ज्वाला, --व्यथा bellyache, colic. --यंत्रणा, --यातना pain endured by the child in the womb.

k.v: पिचण्डकुक्षी जठरोदरं तुन्दं स्तनौ कुचौ। चूचुकं तु कुचाग्रं स्यान्न ना क्रोडं भुजान्तरम्.।
जठरः कठिनेऽपि स्यादधस्तादपि चाधरः। अनाकुलेऽपि चैकाग्रो व्यग्रो व्यासक्त आकुले॥

m: जठर—गद m. a morbid affection of the abdomen or bowels (= हृद्-रोग, Sch.), VarBṛS. civ, 6 and 13.
जठर—ज्वाला f. belly-ache, colic, W.
जठर—ज्वलन n. ‘stomach-heat’, hunger, Bhām. i, 49.

v: pu॰ jaWaraM nudati recanAya nuda--kvip 6 ta॰ AragbaDe (sA~dAla) Sabdaca॰ tasya sevane hi udaraBaNgAtasya taTAtvam ।
m: जठर—नुद् m. ‘removing the Jaṭhara disease’, Cathartocarpus fistula, L.

s: puM, (nudatIti । nud + kvip । tataH zazWItatpuruzaH । etatsevanenodaraBaNgAdevAsya taTAtvam .) AragvaDavfkzaH । iti SabdacandrikA ॥

m: जठर—रोग m. = -गद, VarBṛS. civ, 16.
जठर—स्थायिन् mfn. id., W.
जठर—स्थ mfn. being in the belly or in the womb, W.
जठर—स्थित mfn. id., W.
जठर—त्व n., ‘hardness’, only अ- neg., tenderness, Vām. iii, 1, 19.
जठर—व्यथा f. = -ज्वाला, W.
जठर—यन्त्रणा f. pain endured (by the embryo) in the womb, W.
जठरेण (एण), instr. ind. (opposed to पृष्ठ-तस्) so as to turn the face towards, Hit. ii, 3, 3
जठरिन् mfn. affected with the Jaṭhara disease, Car. v, 6, vi, 18; Suśr. iv, 18, 32.
जठरोत्सव m. a festive dinner, L.
